# Hair by Hannah Richards

> Hannah Richards is a hairstylist at Salon Zinnia, 641 Camino de los Mares, San Clemente, CA 92673. She specializes in custom blondes and lived-in color, and also does haircuts and layers, men's cuts, kids' cuts and blowouts. New clients welcome.

- Days: Tuesday, Thursday, Friday (Saturdays coming soon)
